operations.name: action.delete
operations.description: Delete an action, or delete one step from an action when step_id is provided.

action_id.description: Action id from action.list; defaults to active action

step_id.description: Optional step id to delete inside the action instead of deleting the action

operations.name: action.list
operations.description: List saved action sets, actions, steps, and recorder/playback status.

operations.name: action.play
operations.description: Play a saved action through the workflow engine (same path as workflow.run). Disabled steps are skipped and reported; an enabled step that cannot replay refuses the run before anything changes; a failing step stops it and keeps the partial result.

action_id.description: Action id from action.list; defaults to active action

inputs.description: Values for the workflow's declared inputs, by name (layer inputs take a layer ID from this document)

consent.description: Advance consent: IDs of the irreversible barrier steps (export, external write, paid AI, document lifecycle) this run may perform; nested steps are "outer/inner". workflow.validate lists them

on_failure.description: stop (default): keep the partial result as an inspectable checkpoint. rollback: roll back the run-owned edits since the last checkpoint when safe; canceled runs always stop

operations.name: action.record_start
operations.description: Start recording into an action: recordable op calls AND real UI edits (tool strokes, menus, dialogs — captured at the shared Command layer; edits with no op equivalent record as unreplayable steps). Provide action_id to append to an existing action, or set_id/name to create a new action in a set. clear=true empties the target action first.

set_id.description: Action set id from action.list; used when creating by name

name.description: New action name when action_id is omitted
